notes.note: Reviewed explicit scratch:state registration against classifyStationHomeRoot and the archive/update snapshot exclusions. Unknown in-home roots already follow the state path; naming scratch changes scan completeness without excluding files or changing rollback. Media-tools external classification, security/automation state, channel rollback instructions and CLI backup guarantees remain unchanged. New Windows chat folders outside Station home are unaffected. The existing registry scan failed before this addition and all five registry tests passed afterward.
